neighbours.label: a totality modifier (complete, full, closed) in a fixed compound such as complete game, full refund, closed-toe shoes, full-time
fire: The ace finished the season with four complete games and two shutouts.
If the concert is cancelled, every buyer will receive a full refund.
Kitchen staff are required to wear closed-toe shoes on every shift.

The museum owns a complete set of the original stamps.
Lab rules say closed shoes and long trousers must be worn at all times.

The museum owns a rare sketch by the original engraver.
Lab rules say goggles and gloves must be worn at all times.
After the surgery he went home to rest within three days.
